messages:
ian: FYI getting SEV escalations — multiple customers reporting 502/504 on hosted /v1/generate since ~09:12 PST. Example: short bursts -> 5xx. Logs show memcached evictions + gateway upstream timeouts. Anyone owning prefix cache?

maria: confirmed, tickets from ACME & Lift.ai. I grabbed a sample request/response from a customer. @sam can you pull cache metrics?

sam: pulling metrics now. memcached eviction rate spiked at 09:10, connection errors at gateway also spiked. Prefix cache miss ratio jumped ~4x. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/graphs/kv-evictions (link)

ella: oncall here — investigating. first hypothesis: cache thrash causing KV timeouts which cascade to gateway 504s. checking memcached pods for OOM/evictions and socket errors.

lee: runtime note — we flipped aggressive ttl-downscaling for small-prefixs (PR #4321) last night to reduce cache pressure. if that reduced effective TTLs we could be thrashing. logs show repeated "STORE failed: out of memory" from memcached cluster.

raj: ML note — we increased model shard max_concurrent_streams yesterday; that increases request fanout to the cache layer. not directly a KV change but could amplify cache pressure. I'm checking request patterns now.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-152 memcached-thrashing. Paging oncall@redwood.

ella: evictions line up with a heavy short-lived request stream from a single customer (api_key: acct_9xx). They split traffic across many keys so per-key rate limits didn't trigger. I've applied an emergency gateway throttle on that key.

ian: repro steps from support:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer acct_9xx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"rw/gpt-medium","input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":256}'
```
Response: 504 Gateway Timeout after ~8s. Gateway logs: "upstream response timeout" and upstream returned 502 in some cases.

lee: mitigation plan: increase memcached pool size, scale replicas, and enable local-request fallback (serve LRU snapshot) so requests can succeed during KV flaps. I'll push config change for immediate relief.

deploy-bot: rolling update started for memcached: replicas 4 -> 6, env CACHE_POOL=extended (deploy id df4a2).

sam: watching metrics — eviction rate dropping, avg backend latency down ~60% within 5m. 5xx count trending down.

maria: support actioned — notified affected customers, offered SLA credits where applicable, and opened follow-ups to confirm client-side retry guidance. Sending template message now.

raj: next steps: rollback ttl-downscaling flag tomorrow AM, add a canary test for memcached eviction under load, and tighten per-customer throttling to prevent multi-key sharding from bypassing limits. I'll own the tests.

ella: postmortem checklist: capture prefix cache trace logs, eviction timeline, PR #4321 diff, gateway throttling timeline, and customer request traces (acct_9xx). assigning @lee for root-cause writeup and @sam for mitigation doc.

ian: thanks everyone — I'll keep tickets open until comms are confirmed and the postmortem is posted. :thumbsup:
